definition: to leave your bed after sleeping
exampleSentence: It is hard to get out of bed on cold mornings.
exampleTranslation: Những buổi sáng lạnh rất khó ra khỏi giường.

definition: to push your arms or legs out to their full length
exampleSentence: I stretch my arms when I get out of bed.
exampleTranslation: Tôi vươn vai khi ra khỏi giường.

definition: to open your mouth wide and breathe in because you are tired
exampleSentence: I yawn a lot in the morning.
exampleTranslation: Buổi sáng tôi ngáp rất nhiều.

definition: to press and move your hands on your eyes, often when sleepy
exampleSentence: The child rubbed her eyes and sat up.
exampleTranslation: Đứa bé dụi mắt rồi ngồi dậy.

definition: to stop the alarm clock from ringing
exampleSentence: I turn off the alarm and go back to sleep.
exampleTranslation: Tôi tắt báo thức rồi ngủ tiếp.

definition: to choose the time when the alarm will ring
exampleSentence: I set the alarm for six o'clock.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đặt báo thức lúc sáu giờ.

definition: to press the button that lets you sleep a few more minutes
translation: bấm báo lại, ngủ thêm vài phút
exampleSentence: I always hit the snooze button twice.
exampleTranslation: Lần nào tôi cũng bấm báo lại hai lần.

definition: to pull the curtains apart to let light in
exampleSentence: She opens the curtains to let in the sun.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy mở rèm để đón ánh nắng.

definition: to close the curtains by pulling them across a window
exampleSentence: Please draw the curtains. The room is too bright.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn kéo rèm lại. Phòng sáng quá.

definition: to look at a clock or watch to see what time it is
exampleSentence: I check the time on my phone.
exampleTranslation: Tôi xem giờ trên điện thoại.

definition: to look at yourself in a mirror
exampleSentence: He looks in the mirror before he leaves.
exampleTranslation: Trước khi ra khỏi nhà, bạn ấy soi gương.

definition: to go to the toilet, or to the room with a toilet
translation: đi vệ sinh, vào nhà tắm
exampleSentence: I go to the bathroom as soon as I wake up.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đi vệ sinh ngay khi thức dậy.

definition: to make your hair tidy with a brush
exampleSentence: She brushes her hair every morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nào cô ấy cũng chải tóc.

definition: to fasten your hair behind your head
exampleSentence: I tie my hair back when I cook.
exampleTranslation: Tôi buộc tóc ra sau khi nấu ăn.

definition: to clean your face with water and soap
exampleSentence: I wash my face with cold water.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rửa mặt bằng nước lạnh.

definition: to throw water lightly onto your face
exampleSentence: I splash water on my face to wake up.
exampleTranslation: Tôi vã nước lên mặt cho tỉnh ngủ.

definition: to remove water from your face with a towel
exampleSentence: Dry your face with a clean towel.
exampleTranslation: Hãy lau khô mặt bằng khăn sạch.

definition: to rub a soft cream on your skin
exampleSentence: I put on lotion after I shower.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thoa kem dưỡng sau khi tắm.

definition: to rub a cream on your skin to protect it from the sun
exampleSentence: Put on sunscreen before you go out.
exampleTranslation: Hãy thoa kem chống nắng trước khi ra ngoài.

definition: to swallow vitamin tablets
exampleSentence: I take my vitamins with breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi uống vitamin cùng bữa sáng.

definition: to find out how heavy you are using scales
exampleSentence: I weigh myself every Monday.
exampleTranslation: Thứ Hai nào tôi cũng tự cân.

definition: to look at your phone for messages or news
exampleSentence: I check my phone as soon as I wake up.
exampleTranslation: Tôi xem điện thoại ngay khi thức dậy.

definition: to prepare coffee in a cup
exampleSentence: I make a cup of coffee before work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi pha một tách cà phê trước khi đi làm.

definition: to go out of your home
exampleSentence: We leave the house at seven thirty.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ra khỏi nhà lúc bảy rưỡi.

definition: to lock all the doors and windows of a building
translation: khóa cửa nhà, khóa hết cửa
exampleSentence: He locks up and walks to the bus stop.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy khóa cửa rồi đi bộ ra trạm xe buýt.
